data.body: **[P2] Exercise or document the layer's actual runtime dependencies.** The conformance function supplies `opentelemetry-sdk`, so it does not test the checked-in layer guidance claiming the no-arg agent path needs no additional OTel dependencies. A function following that guidance can lack the `io.opentelemetry.sdk.*` classes referenced by the single-JAR layer. Either package the required runtime jars and remove this dependency from conformance, or document the application dependency explicitly and test that contract.
